act: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (48 CFR chapter 2) and Class Deviation 2026-O0041, Revision 1

en.title: DFARS 225.7018-2(a)(2) and clause 252.225-7961: does “mined, refined, or separated” reach ore and feedstock stages?
en.summary: For contracts awarded on or after January 1, 2027, Class Deviation 2026-O0041, Revision 1, bars covered material “mined, refined, or separated in any covered country”, and clause 252.225-7961 uses the same words. The earlier clause 252.225-7052 described the restriction for each listed material, from mining or production of an ore or feedstock, including recycled material, through finished products. One reading applies the new words to the ore and feedstock stages from which the listed material is made. The other limits them to the listed covered material itself.
en.impact: No contract with a different result under the two readings has been established.
en.correction: Please clarify how the revised wording applies to earlier ore and feedstock stages.

quotes.source: DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0041, Revision 1 (July 1, 2026), Attachment A1: FAR Overhaul Part 25 and DFARS Part 225
quotes.text: Do not award a contract on or after January 1, 2027, for any covered material mined, refined, or separated in any covered country.

quotes.source: DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0041, Revision 1 (July 1, 2026), Attachment A1: FAR Overhaul Part 25 and DFARS Part 225
quotes.text: The Contractor shall not deliver under a contract awarded on or after January 1, 2027, any covered material mined, refined, or separated in any covered country.
this restriction includes mining or production of a tungsten ore or feedstock, including recycled material, through production of tungsten metal powders

for samarium-cobalt magnets this restriction includes the entire supply chain from mining or production of a cobalt and samarium ore or feedstock, including recycled material, through production of finished magnets
